createImage.name: createImage
createImage.description: Creates an image from a template with provided data.

data.description: JSON data with overrides array to populate the template. Format: {"overrides": [{"name": "object_name", "property": "value"}]}.

generationDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before PDF generation

meta.description: Specify an external reference ID for your own reference

aiMetadata.description: Renders a new image from a saved APITemplate.io template, merging in the supplied JSON `overrides` array to fill template objects. Requires a template ID (pick from the dropdown). Not idempotent: each call generates and stores a new image with its own transaction reference.

html.description: The HTML content to convert to PDF. Can include CSS styles and external resources.

css.description: Optional CSS styles to apply to the HTML content. Can include inline styles or external stylesheets.

data.description: Optional JSON data to use for templating the HTML content. Can include variables and dynamic content.

expiration.description: Expiration of the generated PDF in minutes. Use 0 to store permanently, or 1-10080 minutes (7 days) to specify expiration.

printBackground.description: Whether to print background graphics and colors

displayHeaderFooter.description: Whether to display header and footer

scale.description: Scale factor for the PDF (0.1 to 2.0)

waitForTimeout.description: Time to wait before generating PDF (in milliseconds)

meta.description: Specify an external reference ID for your own reference

aiMetadata.description: Renders a new PDF directly from raw HTML (with optional CSS, templating data, and page settings such as size, orientation, margins, and headers/footers). Use when you have ad-hoc HTML markup rather than a saved template or a live URL. Requires the HTML body. Not idempotent: each call generates and stores a new PDF.

createPdfFromUrl.name: createPdfFromUrl
createPdfFromUrl.description: Creates a PDF from a webpage URL.

url.description: The URL of the webpage to convert to PDF

expiration.description: Expiration of the generated PDF in minutes. Use 0 to store permanently, or 1-10080 minutes (7 days) to specify expiration.

printBackground.description: Whether to print background graphics and colors

displayHeaderFooter.description: Whether to display header and footer

scale.description: Scale factor for the PDF (0.1 to 2.0)

waitForTimeout.description: Time to wait for page to load before generating PDF (in milliseconds)

waitForSelector.description: CSS selector to wait for before generating PDF (e.g., ".content-loaded")

meta.description: Specify an external reference ID for your own reference

aiMetadata.description: Renders a new PDF by loading and capturing a live webpage at the given URL, with optional page settings (size, orientation, margins), viewport sizing, full-page capture, and wait-for-selector/timeout controls for dynamic content. Use when the source is a public web page rather than supplied HTML or a saved template. Requires the URL. Not idempotent: each call generates and stores a new PDF.

createPdf.name: createPdf
createPdf.description: Creates a PDF from a template with provided data.

data.description: JSON data with overrides array to populate the template. Format: {"overrides": [{"name": "object_name", "property": "value"}]}.

expiration.description: Expiration of the generated PDF in minutes. Use 0 to store permanently, or 1-10080 minutes (7 days) to specify expiration.

generationDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before PDF generation

meta.description: Specify an external reference ID for your own reference

aiMetadata.description: Renders a new PDF from a saved APITemplate.io template, merging in the supplied JSON `overrides` array to fill template objects. Use when the layout is already designed as a template; for ad-hoc HTML or a webpage use the from-HTML or from-URL actions instead. Requires a template ID. Not idempotent: each call generates and stores a new PDF.

deleteObject.name: deleteObject
deleteObject.description: Deletes a generated PDF or image by its transaction reference or object ID.

transactionRef.description: Select a transaction reference to filter objects.

aiMetadata.description: Permanently deletes a previously generated PDF or image, identified by its transaction reference (pick from the dropdown of recent objects). Use to clean up stored output. Idempotent in effect: once the object is gone, repeating the call leaves the same deleted state.

getAccountInformation.name: getAccountInformation
getAccountInformation.description: Retrieves account information including usage statistics and account details.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the APITemplate.io account profile, including plan and generation usage/quota stats. Use to check remaining quota or account status before generating documents. Read-only and idempotent; takes no input.

listObjects.name: listObjects
listObjects.description: Retrieves a list of generated PDFs and images with optional filtering

limit.description: Maximum number of objects to return (default: 300, max: 300)

offset.description: Number of objects to skip for pagination (default: 0)

dateFrom.description: Start date for filtering (YYYY-MM-DD format, optional)

dateTo.description: End date for filtering (YYYY-MM-DD format, optional)

meta.description: Filter by external reference ID (meta field)

aiMetadata.description: Lists previously generated PDFs and images for the account, optionally narrowed by template ID, transaction reference, date range, or external reference (meta); with no filters it returns the full recent set. Supports limit/offset pagination (max 300 per call). Read-only and idempotent.
